info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Payouts-v2-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Payouts API provides a comprehensive view of insurance claim payouts, enabling users to access detailed information about the financial resolutions associated with each claim. This endpoint allows consumers, such as claims adjusters and insurance analysts, to efficiently retrieve payout data for existing claims. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline the claims process, improve reporting accuracy, and enhance decision-making. The API is designed to support insurance companies in monitoring claim payouts and ensuring timely settlements for their clients.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about claim payouts for a specific claim. It provides insights into the payout amounts, statuses, and any related information necessary for understanding the claim's financial resolution.
